hypothesis: Packed FLA uses N*ceil(max_span/64) chunk descriptors; real per-sequence chunks need fewer entries. Tight capacity-bounded compact descriptors plus no-op guards in output/recompute kernels can remove wasted launch/matmul work without changing valid chunk arithmetic.
isolated_variable: DRAMA3_COMPACT_GDN=1; graph-owned descriptor buffers and invalid chunk guards only; no convolution/backend/precision/expert change.
fixed_controls: same real inputs, native fulltop8 FP8 scales, BF16 dense/GDN, same graph shapes/span and hardware; no cache/clock changes; initialization after captures.
correctness: same-input complete outputs and all GDN/conv/KV/request states exact; untouched slots exact; empty sequences, partial chunks, changed layouts, reused slots, span512 fallback; parent padded/packed behavior preserved.
timing: one short diagnostic, alternate serial-control/candidate CUDA events after exact validation; not a serving speedup claim.
stop: Retain first numerical/ownership failure; do not relax equality. If full mixed median has no useful gain, do not promote or run service.
gpu: GPU2 only after source frozen and verified idle; root owns GPU0
